contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN] ; D/ [...] AVG

A copper-alloy Nummus, House of Constantine, AD347-348 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads: [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]. Reverse shows Two Victories. Obverse legend reads: [...] AVG. Obverse shows Diademed bust facing right. Die axis is 6 o'clock
